title: Advertisement for the post of Research Associate
text:

FULL TEXT:
Advertisement for one post of one Research Associate-I
Applications are invited along with the complete bio-data and attested copies of certificates
showing qualifications and experience for one post of Research Associate-1 (RA-I) @
Rs.58,000/- in the research project entitled “Chemistry and Biology of Organochalcogen
Compounds” sponsored by The National Academy of Sciences of India (NASI), Prayagraj to
Professor K. K. Bhasin. The appointment is till December 31, 2025. Applications should reach
the undersigned by March 28, 2025 either by post or email at kkbhasin@pu.ac.in
Eligibility: Ph.D. in Chemistry.
Desirable: Experience with synthesis and characterization of organoselenium compounds and their
biological testing.
Emoluments: as per DST guidelines
Note: No TA/DA will be provided.
The post is purely temporary and commensurate with the project. Candidates should
mention their e-mail address, phone number and submit application to the undersigned
latest by March 28, 2025.
(K.K.BHASIN)
Professor Emeritus Panjab University &
NASI Platinum Jubilee Fellow,
Centre of Advanced Studies in Chemistry
Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014.
